title: Arginine 11, Arginine 32, and Lysine 44 of a Staphylococcal Anti-sigma Factor are Indispensable Residues.
authors: Sinha, Debasmita; Sinha, Debabrata; Chakraborty, Tushar; Sau, Subrata
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构建模、分子对接和模拟研究金黄色葡萄球菌抗sigma因子RsbW的关键精氨酸/赖氨酸残基在二聚化及与sigma(B)结构域结合中的作用，属于蛋白质-DNA/蛋白互作机制建模，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移，故评6分。
abstract: sigma(B), a Staphylococcus aureus-encoded alternative sigma factor, is inhibited by RsbW, an anti-sigma factor. RsbW also dimerizes in solution and phosphorylates RsbV, an RsbW antagonist. Of the predicted RsbW residues involved in its dimerization and/or binding cognate factors, the roles of Arg 11, Arg 32, and Lys 44 have been demonstrated here using various tools. The structural models of three RsbW mutants, harboring Ala at positions 11, 32, and 44, were built up, and their analyses suggested that all of the above Lys/Arg residues may be involved in the dimerization of this protein. Similar analyses indicated that Lys 44 and Arg 32 may be needed for binding sigma(B3), the domain 3 of sigma(B). The docking studies have confirmed the roles of Arg 11 and Arg 32 in the dimerization of RsbW, and revealed that its association with sigma(B3) requires Arg 32 and Lys 44. Additionally, the simulation studies proposed that all of the above Lys/Arg may be needed for its structure maintenance. To verify the computational data, three Ala-substituted RsbW mutants were also purified, and their characterization indicates that the change of Arg 11 or Lys 44 to Ala, compared to the change of Arg 32 to Ala, impacts the structure, RsbV/ sigma(B3) binding affinity, and phosphorylation activity of RsbW more severely. Further, the dimerization ability of RsbW was partly affected by Ala substitution at positions 11 and 32. Jointly, Arg 11, Arg 32, and Lys 44 of RsbW are crucial residues for this sigma(B) inhibitor and kinase. Knowledge of crucial RsbW residues may be useful for designing antistaphylococcal drugs in the future.
abstract_zh: sigma(B) 是一种由金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）编码的替代sigma因子，其活性受到抗sigma因子RsbW的抑制。RsbW在溶液中还能二聚化，并磷酸化其拮抗剂RsbV。在预测的RsbW残基中，涉及二聚化和/或与同源因子结合的残基中，Arg 11、Arg 32和Lys 44的作用已在此通过多种工具得到证实。我们构建了三个RsbW突变体（在第11、32和44位引入Ala）的结构模型，分析表明上述所有Lys/Arg残基可能参与该蛋白的二聚化。类似分析还表明，Lys 44和Arg 32可能为结合sigma(B3)（sigma(B)的结构域3）所必需。对接研究证实了Arg 11和Arg 32在RsbW二聚化中的作用，并揭示其与sigma(B3)的结合需要Arg 32和Lys 44。此外，模拟研究提出，上述所有Lys/Arg可能对其结构维持是必需的。为验证计算数据，我们还纯化了三个Ala取代的RsbW突变体，其表征表明，与Arg 32变为Ala相比，Arg 11或Lys 44变为Ala对RsbW的结构、RsbV/sigma(B3)结合亲和力及磷酸化活性的影响更为严重。进一步地，RsbW的二聚化能力在第11和32位Ala取代时部分受到影响。综合来看，RsbW的Arg 11、Arg 32和Lys 44是该sigma(B)抑制剂和激酶的关键残基。对RsbW关键残基的了解可能有助于未来设计抗葡萄球菌药物。
